The CNDP communiqué reported 2026-08-29 gives guidance and a public information line under Law 09-08; it states no sanction or decision.

The CNDP president describes the Data-Tika programme with public and private controllers, prior notifications to the CNDP and a possible sanctions step; he gives no sanction, decision or count.

fact: The article calls Law 09-08 Morocco's existing personal data law, with which the draft Digital X.0 law is aligned; no event date is given, so the published date 2025-11-04 is used.

The article reports a draft framework law 'Digital X.0' on AI, data governance, digital identity and interoperability, under review by the General Secretariat of the Government and presented by the Minister Delegate for Digital Transition; it sets principles for data flow and protection (a bill within a larger law); date is the published date.
The CNDP communique states that articles 45 to 50 of law 09-08 give the CNDP the keeping and public availability of the national register of personal data processing.
The CNDP, installed in 2010, is stated to be acting under law 09-08, keeping the national register of processing operations covering 2010 to 31 December 2022.

The CNDP published a first version of the national register (RN-PDP) of notified processing operations on 16 January 2023, with a definitive version on 28 February 2023 and a public complaints-and-controls register from 31 March 2023; no decision or count is given.

The CNDP, Morocco's national commission for the control of personal data protection, validated five new deliberations (D-939 to D-943 of 2025) on 28 November 2025, showing it acting as the supervisory body.

The CNDP published five deliberations dated 28 November 2025 setting model declaration and authorisation forms for cookies, newsletters, patient follow-up, healthcare video surveillance and workplace access control, with no decision on a named controller.
